summary.name: iCopy
summary.one_liner: iCopy is a free Mac clipboard manager with a clipboard history panel and a quick-reply tool for sending saved text, images and files to customers or contacts.
use_cases: Recalling previously copied text, images or files on a Mac
Storing reusable replies for customer service or sales chats
Stacking several clipboard items and pasting them in sequence
Backing up and transferring clipboard or reply data between machines
summary.what_it_does:
The app keeps a searchable clipboard history on macOS, sorted into text, image and file categories, with favorites and groups. It offers a clipboard stack, a blacklist for apps to ignore, a disk-size limit for clipboard content, and plain-text paste. A separate quick-reply panel, opened with a shortcut, lets users save custom phrases or rich text, images, emoji and files and insert them with number keys, Enter or double-click. Clipboard and reply data can be imported and exported, backed up to iCloud, and styled with several themes.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Combined clipboard history and quick-reply panel in one Mac app
Clipboard stack and per-app clipboard monitoring blacklist
iCloud backup and import/export of clipboard and reply data
Native support for Apple silicon and Intel; requires macOS 10.14 or later
caveats: The App Store page shows no overall rating because it has not received enough ratings or reviews
Developer privacy label lists usage data and diagnostics that may be collected, not linked to the user
Support is via QQ group and the developer's website, with usage terms hosted on a third-party site
